subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard accept a new fail-closed review-gate lifecycle with a durable `ready_to_merge` status, or should this flow be redesigned around existing statuses before merge?
rationale: The PR changes persisted Workboard state and completion behavior in ways that can affect existing Workboard users and upgrades, so code repair alone cannot choose the permanent lifecycle contract.

options.title: Accept after coherent repair
options.body: Keep the review-gate direction, but require the PR to fix the completion gate, response envelope, metadata declarations, UI consumers, tests, and real proof before merge.

options.title: Redesign without new status
options.body: Require the contributor to express approval with existing statuses or metadata if maintainers do not want `ready_to_merge` as durable card state.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave the PR open or close later if maintainers do not want to sponsor this Workboard lifecycle yet.

recommendation.title: Accept after coherent repair
recommendation.body: Keep the review-gate direction, but require the PR to fix the completion gate, response envelope, metadata declarations, UI consumers, tests, and real proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest Workboard lifecycle, manifest, and stored-state history in the sampled commit trail.
